_about: Enforced triangle budgets and LOD switch distances for the skier and snowboarder models. The Blender build reads this file; the Unity import will read the same file. Distances are metres at lodBias 1 with a 60 degree vertical field of view at 1080p, where a 1.75 m figure is about 1,637 / distance pixels tall. The counts are a skier with skis and poles; a snowboarder is about a tenth lighter. Beyond the last distance a skier is a coloured dot (task 4.13). Ladder from the adversarial close-up audit of 2026-11-12 (owner: more LODs, a bigger budget up close).
